title: A Zeroth-Order Paradigm for LLM Preference Alignment
why_read: A new zeroth-order alignment method for LLM preference tuning with theoretical guarantees is relevant to researchers working on RLHF alternatives.
analysis: ComPO proposes optimizing LLM preference alignment using comparison oracles rather than directly differentiating a preference loss, targeting a known issue called likelihood displacement in methods like DPO. The paper provides convergence guarantees under certain conditions and extends to an online variant using KL control against a reference policy. Experiments across several open model families show improvements in win rates over existing direct alignment baselines, making this a reasonably rigorous contribution to the alignment literature, though its practical impact depends on validation beyond synthetic win-rate metrics.
